$comment: The deterministic research corpus. Both language runners script the mock adapter from this file, so 'what the sources reported' and 'what the skeptics argued' are committed fixtures and not code. Nothing here is fetched; the links are opaque identifiers and no runner reads a clock. The corpus deliberately contains all four verdict cases: one claim proposed independently by two sources (supported), one claim a skeptic genuinely contradicts with resolvable counter-evidence (contradicted, kept in the evidence table with the contradiction), one claim citing no source item (rejected by the citation-coverage gate with a recorded reason), and one single-source claim with no contradiction (insufficient-evidence). Skeptic slots are keyed by slot number; slot order is the cited claims sorted by their stable hash-derived claim id, which both language lanes recompute and cross-check at run time.
